about.media1subtitle:
Plan ₿ Network is a joint initiative between Tether, Fulgur Ventures and DécouvreBitcoin led by Rogzy & Giacomo Zucco.

Our mission is to offer worldwide Bitcoin solutions to make Bitcoin mass adoption easier, we focus around three major areas:
  • Academic resources to spread knowledge
  • Community building to stay decentralized
  • Start-up support to drive innovation

Our experts and founders' network share common values that help guide us throughout our journey.
about.media1title: A global ecosystem of builders focus on Bitcoin
about.media2subtitle: At Plan ₿ Network, we believe Bitcoin can change the world for the better. We are aware this transformation will require the collective effort of millions of people over decades. Following this vision, we are building a network of partners, builders, communities, and educators who support one another in this common direction.
about.media2title: The Plan ₿ Family — a gathering of people working to change the world

ourValues.1subtext: We stand for a future powered by Bitcoin: unstoppable, peer-to-peer sound money that belongs to everyone.
ourValues.2subtext: We aim to promote the free flow of knowledge and to help build more open-source solutions.
ourValues.3subtext: We consider privacy to be one of the most fundamental human rights and essential for progress.
ourValues.4subtext: We see freedom as the foundation of human progress, shaping our work in peer-to-peer technology, ethics, and real-world solutions.
ourValues.5subtext: We design tools for massive, permissionless use, enabling resilience and independence from top-down attacks.
ourValues.6subtext: We trust in communities—the backbone of Bitcoin—with plebs everywhere carrying the movement into every village and city.
ourValues.title: Our values

about.subtitle: Founded in 2024 by passionate Bitcoiners, the Plan ₿ Network initiative aims to provide tools that support the Bitcoin ecosystem in its growth toward mass adoption.

academy.blockTitle1Subtext: Our large database of educational courses and resources helps everyone understand what Bitcoin is. From its monetary value and network effects to protocol characteristics, our teacher-led and self-paced courses will help you gain an edge in this industry.
academy.blockTitle2Subtext: We design and deliver high-quality Bitcoin education programs for both individuals and companies. From our own specialized learning tracks to custom training solutions developed with partners, we equip people and teams with the knowledge and tools to succeed across technical, business, and strategic domains.
academy.blockTitle3Subtext: Plan ₿ Academy bring years of expertise to offer institution-grade Bitcoin advisory and training. Globally available, our team designs custom tracks for specific audiences such as law, business, computer science, engineering, and economics. We stand ready to seed and scale public programs, university partnerships, and enterprise integration.

salvador.subtitle: El Salvador
salvador.text: The Node Nation initiative is a high school program launched in 2023 in El Salvador. In collaboration with local educator Pupusas G, the Bitcoin Office, and DécouvreBitcoin, this program aims to set up Bitcoin nodes in schools to help students master Bitcoin knowledge in a highly engaging way. With the help of a local team of educators, this initiative has already been implemented in more than 30 high schools across the country and aims to scale to 5,000 public schools.
salvador.title: High-school national program
